# Calendar ERROR migration strengthens loader, persistence and attachment failure paths

Part 3 makes a duplicate async Calendar load reject instead of logging and returning. It removes the local savePrefFile catch after setting the sort-order preference, so a throw can skip the ordered-event callback's following selection update. It also stops attachment setup when a cloud provider is absent. The owned attachment function throws synchronously; accepted later async entry points reject and the account-key caller awaits them. These are scoped failure contracts, not proof of durable preference writes, startup recovery or a reproduced failure.

Scope: Calendar logging migration part 3 control flow.
